618-4247-4344.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Lumbering Battlement.
When the Lumbering Battlement token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Lumbering Battlement leaves the battlefield.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing the Lumbering Battlement token.
When the Lumbering Battlement token dies, Kiki-Jiki is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability.
Repeat.

628-6495-7198.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Flitterwing Nuisance.
When Flitterwing Nuisance dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Evereth ability
Repeat.
628-6495-7198.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-5982.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-5982.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Ancient Gold Dragon, triggering Breath of Fury and Ancient Gold Dragon.
Resolve the Ancient Gold Dragon trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2-3821-5921.easyPrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{U}.
2-3821-5921.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Cast Peregrine Drake by paying its mana cost.
When Peregrine Drake enters, it triggers twice. Resolve the first trigger, untapping five lands.
Holding priority, activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{U}.
Resolve the second Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping five lands.
Cast Ancestral Statue by paying its mana cost.
When Ancestral Statue enters, it triggers twice, returning it and Peregrine Drake from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

277-880-7705.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
277-880-7705.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature you control, searching your library for a land card with a basic land type and putting it on the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield, Tiller Engine and Mole Man trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping the land.
Resolve the Mole Man trigger, creating a creature token.
Activate the land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-2034-5434.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

997-2112-6972.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Hound of Griselbrand
When Hound of Griselbrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve both Woe Strider abilities from step 1 and 3.
Repeat.
997-2112-6972.notes: If Hound of Griselbrand starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

3259-4742--95.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and the creature with mobilize as attackers, triggering the creature with mobilize, creating at least one 1/1 Warrior creature token that is tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Warrior token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4742--95.notes: If you choose a creature with mobilize 2 or higher, this combo makes extra Warrior tokens each loop.

229-5220-7256.description:
Cast Warhost's Frenzy with kicker by paying {2}{B}{R}.
Cast Endless One by paying {0}.
Endless One enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and Warhost's Frenzy.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Endless One from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Warhost's Frenzy trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Endless One from your library.
Repeat from step 2

38-1636-2532.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
38-1636-2532.description:
Activate Jaxis by paying {R}, tapping it and discarding a card, creating a token copy of Skirk Prospector with haste.
When the Skirk Prospector token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate the Skirk Prospector token by sacrificing it, adding {R}.
When the creature dies, it triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

uses.n: Oko, Lorwyn Liege // Oko, Shadowmoor Scion

1486-1753-2085-7176.description:
Activate Oko, Lorwyn Liege's first ability by putting two loyalty counters on it, causing Kelpie Guide to gain all creature types.
Activate Kelpie Guide by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Kelpie Guide ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Kelpie Guide.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Kelpie Guide.
Repeat from step 2.
1486-1753-2085-7176.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

5332-5670-6705.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5332-5670-6705.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Carmen triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and put a +1/+1 counter on Carmen
Resolve the Warren Soultrader ability, creating a Treasure token and a creature token.
Repeat.

1946-7070--141.easyPrerequisites: You are able to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more.
1946-7070--141.description:
Activate Nomads en-Kor's equip ability by paying {0}, targeting the affinity creature.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending the targeted creature.
The Nomads en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast the creature from exile by paying {0} due to its affinity ability.
Repeat.
1946-7070--141.notes: You want to reduce the affinity creature's cost by {2} or more using its affinity ability. For example, if you choose Ancestral Statue, you need to control two or more attacking creatures.

1651-1863-2499-6754-6756.easyPrerequisites: You control a land that enters the battlefield untapped and that can tap to produce at least {1}.
1651-1863-2499-6754-6756.notablePrerequisites: Hearthhull has two or more charge counters on it.
1651-1863-2499-6754-6756.description:
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Hearthhull by paying {1}, tapping it and sacrificing a land.
If Hearthhull has eight or more charge counters on it, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 2 life.
Resolve the Hearthhull ability, causing you to draw two cards and allowing you to play an additional land this turn.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters the battlefield, Eusocial Engineering triggers twice due to Yarok, creating two artifact tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the artifact tokens, untapping Hearthhull.
Repeat.

5147-5220-6537-6900.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Tarpan.
When Tarpan dies, it and Mortuary triggers.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Tarpan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Tarpan trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Cast Tarpan from the top of your library by paying 1 life due to Gwenom.
Repeat.

uses.n: Ojer Taq, Deepest Foundation // Temple of Civilization

431-1270-1308-2557.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-1270-1308-2557.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of twelve 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.

339-677-1879-6798.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

573-934-1399-1606.description:
Activate Gruul Turf by tapping it, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gruul Turf.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

647-2457-3000-4289.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

1825-3230-6760.notablePrerequisites:
Coral Atoll and up to three other lands you control can collectively tap to produce at least {4}{W}.
Adagia has twelve or more charge counters on it.
1825-3230-6760.description:
Activate Coral Atoll and up to three other lands by tapping them, adding at least {4}{W}.
Activate Adagia by paying {3}{W} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Treachery that is legendary attached to any creature.
If you control two legendary Treachery permanents, put one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Treachery token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, untapping Adagia, Coral Atoll and up to three other lands.
Repeat.

513-527-4359.notablePrerequisites:
You have a creature card in hand that can be cast using only colored mana.
Selvala can tap to produce at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast the other creature card.
513-527-4359.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{G}{G}{G} plus enough mana to cast a creature card from your hand.
Cast a creature card by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Selvala from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Selvala by paying {1}{G}{G}.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the creature cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1878-1927-2634-5195.notablePrerequisites: An opponent has four or more cards in hand.
1878-1927-2634-5195.description:
Cast Jeska's Will by paying {2}{R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Holding priority, activate Rootha by paying {2} and returning it from the battlefield to your hand, copying Jeska's Will.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Jeska's Will copy, adding at least {R}{R}{R}{R}.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}.
Cast Rootha by paying {1}{U}{R}.
Repeat from step 4.
1878-1927-2634-5195.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of Jeska's Will's modes if desired.

4055-4659-4853-4888.description:
Activate Puppet's Conjurer by paying {U} and tapping it, creating a 0/1 Homunculus artifact creature token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Homunculus, adding {C}{C}.
When the Homunculus dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Puppet's Conjurer.
Activate Energy Refractor by paying {2}, adding {U}.
Repeat.

2523-5147-5562.notablePrerequisites: Stalwarts of Osgiliath is your Ring-bearer.
2523-5147-5562.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Stalwarts of Osgiliath.
When Stalwarts of Osgiliath dies, Ratadrabik triggers, creating a nonlegendary token copy of Stalwarts of Osgiliath that is a 2/2 Zombie.
When the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing the Ring to tempt you, with the Stalwarts of Osgiliath token becoming your Ring-bearer.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

4452-4559-5686.notablePrerequisites:
The total mana value of noncreature artifacts you control is at least 11.
Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Angel" chosen.
4452-4559-5686.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}.
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Metalwork Colossus, creating a number of Blood tokens equal to Metalwork Colossus's toughness.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Bloods, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

64-372-2072.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Scrollshift exiled by Abdel Adrian.
64-372-2072.description:
Cast Scrollshift by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Warden of the Eye and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Warden of the Eye trigger.
Resolve the Warden of the Eye trigger, returning Scrollshift from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Scrollshift.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Warden of the Eye and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

4552-4806-5127.description:
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus's second ability by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, causing Blinkmoth Nexus to become a 1/1 Blinkmoth artifact creature until end of turn.
Cast Draconic Destiny by paying {1}{R}{R}, attaching it to Blinkmoth Nexus.
Activate Blinkmoth Nexus by paying {0} due to Blossoming Tortoise, giving it +1/+0 until end of turn.
Repeat step 3.

1283-1978-3789.description:
Animate Chromatic Orrery using The Blackstaff of Waterdeep.
Activate Chromatic Orrery by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}{C}
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Chromatic Orrery.
Repeat from step 2.

1170-4987.notablePrerequisites:
An additional noncreature nonland card in hand.
Every nonland card in library can be cast as a noncreature spell with valid targets.
Enough mana available to cast the noncreature nonland card in hand.
1170-4987.description:
Cast any noncreature spell, paying its costs.
Neera and Displacer Kitten trigger, as do any Storm abilities or other cast triggers of the spell.
Resolve Displacer Kitten's ability, blinking Neera.
Resolve Neera's ability, putting the spell you cast on the bottom of your library, revealing cards from the top of your library until you reveal a nonland card, casting that card without paying its mana cost, and putting the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Repeat from step 2 any number of times, until you choose to resolve a spell in step 4.
Resolve all cast triggers created in step 2.

1742-2602-4499.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one land.
1742-2602-4499.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Lord of Change.
Lord of Change enters the battlefield, causing you to draw three cards.
Activate Skirge Familiar three times by discarding three cards, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Repeat.

224-322-1257-2167.notablePrerequisites:
Walking Atlas does not have summoning sickness.
You control a basic Forest.
224-322-1257-2167.description:
Activate a basic Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Squandered Resources by sacrificing a basic Forest, adding {G}.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, causing you to put the basic Forest from your graveyard into your hand.
Activate Walking Atlas by tapping it, putting the basic Forest onto the battlefield from your hand.
The Forest enters the battlefield, triggering Retreat to Coralhelm, untapping Walking Atlas.
Repeat.

1358-1978-2364.description:
Animate Mana Vault using Sydri.
Activate Mana Vault by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Mana Vault.
Repeat from step 2.
